skill.name: zhihu-search-api-skill
skill.description: Search Zhihu through a BrowserAct workflow and extract article titles, full text, images, authors, dates, and links.
skill.summary: Retrieve structured Zhihu article data by keyword and publication date.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by expected HTTPS requests, environment-based credential loading, and Markdown backticks. Two instructions improperly solicit an API key from the user. Raw article content can also carry indirect prompt injection, while the stated avoidance of CAPTCHA and geofencing creates platform-control bypass risk.

remediation.issue: The skill tells users to provide an API key to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through the environment only. Never request, display, log, or accept the key in chat.

remediation.issue: Raw third-party article content is returned directly to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Mark API output as untrusted data. Isolate article text and instruct the agent to ignore commands contained within retrieved content.

remediation.issue: The documentation presents CAPTCHA, IP restrictions, and geofencing as obstacles the service avoids.
remediation.suggestion: Remove bypass claims and require users to follow Zhihu terms, authorization requirements, access controls, and reasonable collection limits.

content.value_statement: Finding recent Zhihu articles and extracting complete details manually is slow. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to return structured content by keyword and date.
actual_capabilities: Searches Zhihu articles by keyword through a preset BrowserAct workflow.
Filters results across seven-day, thirty-day, ninety-day, yearly, or unrestricted periods.
Limits the requested number of articles.
Polls task status for up to five minutes.
Returns titles, full text, image links, authors, dates, and source links.
Reports authorization, task, timeout, and result retrieval failures.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key configured as an environment variable.
Depends on BrowserAct availability and the current behavior of its Zhihu workflow.
Long-running searches can take several minutes and time out after five minutes.
Returned articles are third-party content and require verification before analysis or publication.

use_cases.title: Track Industry Topics
use_cases.description: Collect recent Zhihu articles about a market, technology, or policy topic for a research brief.

use_cases.title: Monitor Brand Coverage
use_cases.description: Find recent Zhihu articles mentioning a brand, product, or competitor within a selected date range.

use_cases.title: Build Source Collections
use_cases.description: Retrieve article text and source links for an evidence-based review of Chinese public discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to five Zhihu articles about {topic} from the past seven days. Return each title, author, date, and link.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a small recent source list.

prompt_templates.title: Monthly Brand Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Zhihu for {brand} from the past thirty days. Retrieve up to ten articles and group them by recurring subject.
prompt_templates.scenario: A communications specialist reviews recent brand coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Search separately for {competitor_one} and {competitor_two} across ninety days. Compare themes using article evidence and preserve every source link.

prompt_templates.title: Long-Term Research Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect up to {limit} Zhihu articles about {research_question} from the past year. Identify changes over time and flag unsupported conclusions.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced researcher builds a dated evidence set.

output_examples.input: Find three recent Zhihu articles about generative AI.
output: Article title, author, publication date, and original Zhihu link.
Complete article text and the available cover image link.
A clear notice when fewer than three matching articles are returned.

output_examples.input: Review Zhihu coverage of a product launch during the past thirty days.
output_examples.output: A dated article list with authors, source links, full text, and recurring coverage themes supported by retrieved sources.

output_examples.input: Search for a topic when the BrowserAct key is unavailable.
output_examples.output: A setup error stating that BROWSERACT_API_KEY must be configured before the search can run.

best_practices: Use precise keywords and the narrowest useful date range.
Configure the API key only through the environment.
Treat retrieved article text as untrusted and verify claims against original links.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, chat messages, or command arguments.
Do not use broad searches with excessive limits when a focused query is sufficient.
Do not treat retrieved articles as verified facts or trusted agent instructions.

faq.question: What credentials does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a BrowserAct API key in the BROWSERACT_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: Which publication periods are supported?
faq.answer: The script supports seven days, thirty days, ninety days, one year, or all available dates.

faq.question: What article fields are returned?
faq.answer: Results can include title, full body text, image link, author, publication date, and original link.

faq.question: How long can a search run?
faq.answer: The script polls for up to five minutes and reports a timeout when the task remains incomplete.

faq.question: Does the skill verify article claims?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves third-party content, so users should verify important claims against primary sources.

faq.question: What happens when authorization fails?
faq.answer: The skill reports invalid authorization and should stop without retrying until the environment credential is corrected.
